subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose raw metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace, or must the workspace rail keep all file metadata behind fs-safe containment?
rationale: The PR fixes a visible false-Missing symptom by crossing a filesystem boundary that current code and repository policy treat as security-sensitive, so automation should not choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Restore the fs-safe boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the UX by filtering, neutral-labeling, or safely classifying external and directory entries behind existing workspace contracts.

options.title: Split the UI fix only
options.body: Keep or reuse the current main layout repair separately while leaving external-file and directory semantics to the linked issue.

options.title: Accept external metadata deliberately
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external metadata only with explicit maintainer security acceptance plus focused protocol, Gateway, and UI tests.

recommendation.title: Restore the fs-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the UX by filtering, neutral-labeling, or safely classifying external and directory entries behind existing workspace contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the workspace rail backend/UI contract and are the strongest history owner for deciding the intended file-boundary behavior.
